101.description: This feature vector activates strongly on specific Devanagari vowel-consonant character sequences and common word fragments.

28.description: This vector represents Hindi character subwords and linguistic components.

151.description: This vector represents a multilingual mixture of common short function words, suffixes, and character fragments.

108.description: This feature vector activates on character n-grams and suffixes commonly found in Hindi words and proper names.

75.description: This vector is sensitive to common Hindi syllable prefixes and root fragments.

20.description: This vector represents Indic and Cyrillic character sequences and subword fragments involving dental consonants and nasal vowels.

135.description: This vector represents labiodental and bilabial consonant characters and sub-word tokens across different scripts.

144.description: This vector activates strongly on characters, root words, and suffixes specific to the Devanagari script used for Hindi and related languages.

123.description: This vector activates on common Hindi words, prefixes, and subword tokens.

69.description: This vector represents common Hindi vowel sign combinations and diphthongs used in word inflections.
